_comment: 岗位知识的全部对外文字（拒绝原因、导航行）。代码只持有键、协议值和插值；改文案只改这里。

position_required.en: position must be a position name

op_unknown.zh: op 只能是 add / replace / remove / restore
op_unknown.en: op must be one of add / replace / remove / restore

version_required.zh: {op} 需要 expected_version（读一次现状，原样带回）
version_required.en: {op} needs expected_version (read the current state and send it back unchanged)

to_version_required.zh: restore 需要 to_version（岗位快照号）
to_version_required.en: restore needs to_version (a position snapshot number)

when_invalid.zh: when 必须是至多 {max} 个非空字符串（项目引用或路径前缀，路径不含 ..）：{why}
when_invalid.en: when must be at most {max} non-empty strings (project refs or path prefixes, no ..): {why}

snapshot_not_found.zh: 该岗位没有第 {ver} 号快照
snapshot_not_found.en: This position has no snapshot number {ver}

stale.zh: {what}已变（你读到的是 {expected}，现在是 {current}）；先读取现状再改
stale.en: {what} changed (you read {expected}, it is {current}); read the current state first

entry_too_long.zh: 单条岗位经验最多 {limit} 字（这条 {chars} 字，原条目 {before} 字）：要么拆成几条，要么不比原来长
entry_too_long.en: One knowledge entry is at most {limit} characters ({chars} here, was {before}); split it, or keep it no longer than before

over_limit.zh: 岗位经验会超过 {limit} 字上限，且这一版比现在长（{before} → {chars} 字）：请先合并或删除，再重试
over_limit.en: Position knowledge would exceed the {limit}-character limit and is longer than it is now ({before} → {chars}); merge or remove entries first

dispatch: {role} 岗位里与这件 Work 相关的经验：

review_followup.zh: 如这次改正有可复用的经验，承办人可用 office_position_knowledge_update 补一条；没有可跳过。
review_followup.en: If the correction offers a reusable lesson, the assignee can add it with office_position_knowledge_update. Otherwise skip it.

omitted.zh: 还有 {n} 条放不进这里，用 office_position_knowledge_read 读。
omitted.en: {n} more do not fit here; read them with office_position_knowledge_read.

scoped.zh: 另有 {n} 条按项目或路径触发的经验，随相关派工送达。
scoped.en: {n} more entries are tied to a project or path and arrive with the matching work.
